purpose: The shared content-page head: optional eyebrow badge, h1, optional lede.

variants.badge+h1+lede: T-COLLECTION-INDEX, all four T-DETAIL-*, T-COMPARISON, T-ALTERNATIVES-INDEX
variants.h1+strong: T-EBOOK (the h1 wraps its text in <strong>)
variants.h1+lastUpdated:
T-LEGAL (components/block.date-line is NOT used; a plain centred

)
variants.h1+subtitle: T-STORY section 1 — the h1 is the company name and the subtitle sits in a `flex items-center justify-center` block with `mx-[3em]` rather than the usual `mx-auto max-w-[49ch]` lede block

maxWordsBasis: recomputed from the real data: the longest h1 is the 13-word longest blogPosts title; the longest lede is the 44-word longest glossary definition. Both independently derived by iterating the data modules, not copied from a spec.
geometry: pt-[10.2em] (11.8em at <=479px); inner frame w-[108em]; h1 and lede both mx-auto max-w-[49ch] text-center

motion.note: The badge's hover:bg-white is a state, not motion.

responsive.max-wf-tablet: two-column rows stack; the 108em hero frame narrows to 80em
responsive.max-wf-phone: flex rows become flex-col and centre; the hero frame becomes w-full
responsive.max-wf-mini: block margins drop from 4.2em to 3.5em; display headings drop a step; hero top padding rises to 11.8em
responsive.note: All three are MAX-width queries. The em engine is frozen at 8.25833px below 992px, so 768 and 390 differ only by these class overrides.

chRule: `max-w-[49ch]` must stay in ch: 1981.52px on the 65.333px h1 (effectively unconstrained) but 580.714px on the 18.667px lede. Flattening either breaks the layout.
